title: Sounds only
rule: No words at all: the story is told in sound lettering (scrape, tick, tap, creak); the lines become wordless balloons with their rhythm.
declares: the four lines muted (shape and rhythm only)
made: charcoal-card kit (charcoal99.py): articulated grey-card puppets cut from the b1m2 control-point agent and stranger and the b1m2 scenery (desk, chair, ticket window without glazing bars, wall clock at 4:08 and 4:10, cupboard opening on its left jamb, SERVICE door); each piece a separate card with charcoal rubbed in, darker at its cut edges, its own drop shadow; brass split pins at shoulder and elbow; a blown charcoal spray halo on the wall round each figure
the wall: the teuf-teuf Cueva rock relief (plain rock only) flattened to a pale wash and printed through the teuf-teuf greenish-sepia ramp; rubbed charcoal floor band and ground line
the brass key: a light card cut on the ANRC 1922 key silhouette (99-ways-template cutout) on a drawn hook, its tag a blank card
no words: the memo is a pale card with '4:15', a drawn key and an arrow to a drawn cupboard; the SERVICE card carries a drawn key instead of its word; the tag is blank; no TICKET OFFICE lettering

sound lettering in the shared pen hand, fattened and rubbed as charcoal with a pale chalk knock-out: SCRRAPE! (chair), tick, TAP TAP TAP (his steps), tok tok (her glove on the counter), TICK / tock (clock), tok tok tok receding (her heels), CREEEAK (cupboard), tink (key), tick . . . (the silence)

the four lines as wordless cut-card balloons (penlib.balloon_piece outline, no letters): one charcoal dash per syllable at its pitch, stressed syllables longer and heavier, pauses as gaps, and only the end mark in the pen hand: question 8 dashes rising to '?', answer 6 dashes falling to '.', thanks 3 dashes to '!', forgetting 7 dashes with '...' trailing off (last dashes fading) to '?'
hand-ruled panel borders (penlib.border_mask), folio '31 / Sounds only' (pen99.folio)

events.E0: panel 1: SCRRAPE! as he rises from the desk; memo card 4:15 + key -> cupboard; clock 4:08 'tick'; panel 2: TAP TAP TAP across the office toward the closed cupboard
events.E1: panel 3: at the ticket window, her 'tok tok' on the counter; balloon from her: rising rhythm to '?'
events.E2: panel 4: he looks up at the clock (4:10), TICK / tock; balloon from him: falling rhythm to '.'
events.E3: panel 5: she turns away; balloon from her: three dashes to '!'; her heels 'tok tok tok' receding
events.E4: panel 6: CREEEAK, the cupboard door opens on its left jamb; the key on its hook, 'tink'
events.E5: panel 7: pencil to chin; trailing rhythm '...' to '?'; key unmoved; SERVICE door shut; only 'tick . . .'

lines.question: muted: Par-don me | have you the right time ? (8 syllables, rising)
lines.answer: muted: Ten past four, | by the clock . (6 syllables, falling)
lines.thanks: muted: Much o-bliged ! (3 syllables, 3 dashes, the middle one light)
lines.forgetting: muted: Well, | here I am ... | and what for ? (7 syllables, trailing)

beat: the office fills with sound panel by panel: scrape, steps, the question's rhythm, tick and the answer, thanks and heels, the creak; last, the forgetting balloon is laid and its rhythm trails off
beat_frames: b01: panel 1 only: SCRRAPE!, memo, tick (E0)
b03: + panel 3: tok tok, the rising '?' balloon (E1)
b04: + panel 4: TICK/tock, the answer's falling balloon (E2)
b06: + panel 6: CREEEAK, key on hook (E4)
b07: + panel 7 silent: pencil to chin, no balloon yet (E5)
b08: + the trailing '...?' balloon and 'tick . . .' (= the page)

self_check.words_on_page: none except sound lettering (SCRRAPE, tick, TAP, tok, TICK, tock, CREEEAK, tink) and the folio title; numerals only on the memo (4:15)
self_check.check: No word of dialogue appears; question (rising ? from her), answer (falling . from him under the 4:10 clock), thanks (! from her as she turns) and forgetting (trailing ...? at the open cupboard) are found by shape and end mark (maker's judgement from the full-size page; blind reading pending)
